name: ReAct
titleZh: ReAct：让语言模型在推理与行动之间协同
summary: Interleaves reasoning traces with task actions so the model can plan, act, read the result and revise, instead of doing only one of the two.
summaryZh: 让模型把推理轨迹与任务动作交替输出：先想、再做、看结果、再修正，而不是只做其中一件事。
keyFact: ReAct (Yao et al., arXiv:2210.03629, first posted 2022-10-06) made interleaved reasoning-and-acting the default shape of an LLM agent loop. On the ALFWorld and WebShop interactive benchmarks it beat imitation and reinforcement learning baselines by 34 and 10 absolute success-rate points respectively, using only one or two in-context examples.
keyFactZh: ReAct（Yao 等，arXiv:2210.03629，2022-10-06 首次提交）确立了「推理与行动交替」这一 LLM 智能体循环的基本形态。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个交互式基准上，它仅用一两个上下文示例，就把成功率比模仿学习和强化学习基线分别高出 34 与 10 个百分点（绝对值）。
whyItMatters: Every "reason → act → observe" loop in today's agent runtimes descends from this. When you pick a framework, this is the baseline behaviour you can assume it already implements.
whyItMattersZh: 今天所有 Agent 运行时里的「思考 → 行动 → 观察」循环都源自这里。选框架时，这是你可以默认它已经具备的行为基线。
title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
